visualCharacteristics.purpose: row of linked study-type tiles: photo tiles with an overlaid title and arrow, plus text-only link bars stacked in one column
visualCharacteristics.summary: 4-col row: photo tiles with overlaid title+arrow, plus stacked dark text link bars

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile. Cell 1: image (leave empty for a text-only link bar). Cell 2: the tile title as a link (heading or paragraph). Consecutive text-only rows stack together in one grid column. Links to another host open in a new tab
contentPattern.summary: Study type tiles: Repeating linked items of the same kind (study types), each linking to a listing page

usage: Study-type entry points (Grados, Másteres, Doctorados, Formación Permanente, Formación Profesional).
reuseGuidance: Use for a short row of linked category tiles. For editorial cards with descriptions use cards-news.
